messages.subject: CMC listing and draft directions - HT-2026-000142
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

The CMC is listed for 8 May. Please find our proposed directions. We propose separate experts rather than a single joint expert, and disclosure by 5 June. We will resist your client's lost-profit head as a matter for the experts on causation.

Nadia Iqbal
Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.subject: RE: CMC listing and draft directions - HT-2026-000142
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

We're largely agreed on the timetable. We'll ask the Court to consider a single joint expert given the cost, but can live with separate experts if the Court prefers. We will press for disclosure of your client's build and bearing-specification records for the plant.

See you on the 8th.

Kind regards,
Tom
